synthesis.body: python-markdown's attr_list does not escape values: a value containing a double quote terminates the attribute and the remainder becomes markup -- a compiler-emitted label of 'Diagram & "3.1" <script>x</script>' put a live <script> into the published page. A single HTML-escape closes that completely and round-trips the value exactly, including ampersands, em dashes, accents and CJK, so an ASCII allowlist is the wrong control and destroys international text for nothing. But check the value's real sink before choosing the control: where a theme lifts the attribute into Mermaid source as accTitle:, '%%{init:...}%%' is consumed as a Mermaid *directive* and an embedded newline destroys the diagram, so those need rejecting at emission. Escape for the HTML hop, reject for the second hop.

title: attr_list attribute values are not escape-safe, and the sink may not be HTML
